experiment: Exp A data-era ladder @124M (union eval, all arms torch 2.10)
eval_set: wiki_eval_union (2053 docs; union-decontam vs C4 and RefinedWeb)

param_counts.note: @124M = matched DIMENSIONS (12L/12H/768d), NOT matched param count; current-arch's value-embed/U-net additions ARE the algorithm

comparison_to_published.framing: EXPLICIT CORRECTION: all 4 original arms (A0D0/A0D1/A1D0/A1D1) re-run on torch 2.10 and re-scored on the stricter union eval. Threshold essentially unchanged (+0.0016). Both published and corrected arms are torch 2.10, so the published->corrected shift carries NO torch component; it is the union-eval change plus fresh same-seed re-run variance.

torch_neutrality_check.interpretation: At fixed union eval, torch 2.4.1->2.10 shifts the tail threshold by +0.0156 (a0d0_owt) and +0.0007 (a0d1_dclm) — NOT uniformly negligible. Does not affect the published<->corrected comparison (both 2.10); reinforces running every era arm on one torch version.
